specs_json.compute: Intel Core i5 (platform) + i7 (development); optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX

notes: The Unitree B2 is an industrial-grade quadruped rated IP67 with 360 N·m knee joints, >6 m/s top speed, and a 45 Ah (2250 Wh) quick-swap battery giving 4-6 h endurance. It sustains >40 kg continuous walking load (~120 kg standing) and targets power-plant, tunnel, and industrial inspection duty from -20 to 55 °C.

failure_modes.name: Knee actuator thermal derating under load
failure_modes.symptoms: Torque limiting during stair climbs with payload, joint over-temperature faults
failure_modes.mitigation: Respect 40 kg continuous load limit, allow cooldown between high-grade climbs, verify local air-cooling ducts unobstructed

failure_modes.name: Battery cell imbalance in 13S pack
failure_modes.symptoms: Runtime below 4 h unloaded, BMS cell-delta warnings, premature low-voltage cutoffs
failure_modes.mitigation: Full balance-charge weekly, store at ~50% SOC, retire packs with >100 mV persistent cell delta

failure_modes.name: IP67 seal degradation at leg joints
failure_modes.symptoms: Moisture ingress alarms, corrosion on joint boards after washdown or rain ops
failure_modes.mitigation: Inspect seals quarterly and after submersion events, replace gaskets per service interval

failure_modes.name: Foot pad wear and slip
failure_modes.symptoms: Slipping on smooth concrete, degraded stair traction, contact-detection noise
failure_modes.mitigation: Replace foot pads on a distance-based schedule (~500 km), check after abrasive-terrain missions

failure_modes.name: Lidar/camera extrinsic drift
failure_modes.symptoms: Autonomy path errors, mapping ghosting, obstacle false negatives
failure_modes.mitigation: Re-run factory calibration routine after transport or impacts; validate with test course

failure_modes.name: Hip abduction dual-encoder disagreement
failure_modes.symptoms: Sudden joint lockout, robot sits down mid-mission, encoder mismatch fault codes
failure_modes.mitigation: Firmware kept current (OTA), replace encoder assembly on first mismatch fault rather than clearing
